sql: SELECT 'conv' AS k, json_build_object('id', c.id, 'inst', c.instance_id, 'created', c.created_at, 'step', c.bot_step, 'enabled', c.bot_enabled, 'paused_until', c.bot_paused_until, 'paused_reason', c.bot_paused_reason, 'bd', c.bot_data, 'lead', c.lead_id, 'last', c.last_message_at, 'from_me', c.last_message_from_me, 'closed', c.is_closed)::text AS v FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.remote_jid LIKE '%11946419527%' UNION ALL SELECT 'lead', json_build_object('id', l.id, 'status', l.status, 'created', l.created_at, 'updated', l.updated_at, 'unit', l.unit, 'campaign', l.campaign_name, 'company', l.company_id)::text FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.whatsapp LIKE '%11946419527%' UNION ALL SELECT 'msg', json_build_object('t', m.timestamp, 'me', m.from_me, 'type', m.message_type, 'src', m.metadata->>'source', 'c', left(m.content, 70))::text FROM (SELECT m.* FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.remote_jid LIKE '%11946419527%' ORDER BY m.timestamp DESC LIMIT 12) m
